steps.title: Fit the two rear frame rails
Fit the six rear frame nut plates and keeper screws
Bolt the rear crossmember into the rail seats
Bolt the front crossmember into the rail seats
Bolt the fixed ankle cradle onto the rear rails
Fit the pitch limit stops to the cradle
Fit the pitch ring with its bushings between the cradle cheeks
Fit the roll limit stops inside the pitch ring
Fit the keyed roll adapter with its bushings inside the pitch ring
Fit the roll thrust washers
Insert the short roll pins
Fit the roll pin caps and bolts
Fit the pitch thrust washers
Insert the short pitch pins
Fit the pitch pin caps and bolts
Fit the bolted forefoot frame into the fixed hinge supports
Fit the forefoot hinge bushings and thrust washers
Insert the forefoot axle from the outboard side
Fit the forefoot axle cap and hinge limit stops
Bolt the two forefoot actuator clevises to their receivers
Fit the prepared forefoot screw actuator between its clevises
Insert the forefoot eye pins and bolt their keeper plates
Bolt the two pitch actuator clevises to their receivers
Fit the prepared pitch screw actuator between its clevises
Insert the pitch eye pins and bolt their keeper plates
Bolt the two roll actuator clevises to their receivers
Fit the prepared roll screw actuator between its clevises
Insert the roll eye pins and bolt their keeper plates
Bolt the rear sole carrier beneath the rear frame
Bolt the forefoot sole carrier beneath the moving frame
Fit the two heel pads with compression sleeves and bolts
Fit the two midfoot pads with compression sleeves and bolts
Fit the two forefoot pads with compression sleeves and bolts
Bolt the junction box housing to the frame ears
Fit the controller board and four box sockets
Route the main lead and three actuator harnesses with cable clips
Close the junction box with its gasket and bolted lid
Fit the toe cap with captive bolts
Fit the heel cover with captive bolts
Fit the upper foot plate with captive bolts
Fit the inner ankle guard with captive bolts
Fit the outer ankle guard with captive bolts
Fit the shin beam and four M36 flange bolts onto the ankle adapter
Fit the knee journal bearings and thrust spacers
Fit the bolted fork and spar unit over the shin knee boss
Insert the knee axle from the outboard side
Fit the knee axle retaining cap and screws
Fit the twin-engine thruster cradle
Fit the upper and lower knee cylinder mounts
Fit the two thigh-to-shin knee cylinders
Bolt the three hip cylinder lug carriers to the spar
Fit the leg service block and protected U-loop
Fit the rear service channel cable guard
Insert the two thruster units into the cradle rings
Fit the thigh front plate
Fit the outer thigh plate
Fit the inner thigh plate
Fit the two thigh rear covers
Fit the kneecap bracket
Fit the kneecap shield
Fit the outer knee guard and bearing cover
Fit the inner knee guard and bearing cover
Fit the front shin plate
Fit the outer calf shell
Fit the inner calf shell
Fit the rear engine shroud
Fit the central bridge panel
Fit the two calf access hatches
Fit the two calf grab rails
